---
title: "Lesson 3: Matrices and Systems"
---

## Overview

Matrices provide a practical way to represent linear maps and solve systems of equations.

## Intuition

A matrix takes one vector and produces another by linear combination of its columns.

## Formal Definition

A matrix $A \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$ represents a map from $\mathbb{R}^n$ to $\mathbb{R}^m$.

$$
Ax=b
$$

## Examples

- Solving a $2 \times 2$ system
- Row reduction
- Matrix multiplication
